question: Mukesh sells 80% part of a commodity at a profit of 20% and rest of the part at a loss of 5% and in this way earns a profit of ₹9,300. What was the cost price of the commodity for Mukesh?
solution:
**GIVEN:**

Mukesh sells 80% part of a commodity at profit of 20%

Mukesh sells rest part at a loss of 5%

Profit earned is Rs9300

**FORMULA USED:**

S.P. = ( 100 + gain%) /100 × C.P.

S.P. = ( 100 - loss% ) /100 × C.P. 

Profit = S.P. - C.P. 

Where, S.P. = Selling price , C.P. = Cost price
